item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October 2023, Sheikh Hasina received the fuel-delivery certificate and a model of the fuel assembly for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant after the first uranium-fuel batch had arrived. The project involved two 1,200 MW units, Russian financing and technology, planned Russian fuel supply for the first three years, vendor take-back of spent fuel, and reported construction completion of about 90% for unit 1 and 70% for unit 2; production was planned to begin in early 2025.","notes":["The excerpt supports Hasina receiving the certificate and fuel-assembly model, while stating that the first fuel batch had been received at the ceremony site.","The excerpt reports early-2025 production, not a general 2024–2025 operation period."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports all stated commitments, institutional descriptions, licensing claims, and planned operating dates as reported statements or government claims."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the December 2022 mission date, cooperation, expert committees, inspections, ethics code, recommendations, and Bangladesh's stated action-plan response."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the 74% finding, the listed corruption forms and administrative bottlenecks, resource constraints, digitalization-related reduction in some areas, and continuing procurement irregularities."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports these as Sheikh Hasina's parliamentary statements, allegations, denials, and stated Smart Bangladesh plans; it does not independently verify them."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the January 2024 address, the request for another mandate, the Election Commission claims, and the listed self-reported improvements covering the period from 2009 to 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the reported 2023 journalist killings, imprisonment, violence, censorship, propaganda, government attribution, cybersecurity law, army deployment, arrests/legal actions, and BNP boycott."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October 2023, over 60 public-health and global-health practitioners sought greater transparency, oversight, and independent scrutiny in the WHO South-East Asia regional-director selection after Bangladesh nominated Sheikh Hasina's daughter. Critics questioned the nominee's technical and global-health qualifications relative to the role, while she cited nearly a decade of WHO advisory and expert-panel work.","notes":["The excerpt says the letter was signed by over 60 experts/practitioners; it separately refers to universities and international health NGOs, so the summary should not state that more than 60 organizations joined the letter."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the closure, disputed legal grounds, RSF's attribution regarding BNP affiliation, proposed website closures, seven reported attacks, described police conduct, and the cited ranking change."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the reported arrests, overcrowding, rally violence and deaths, internet-blocking allegation, disputed false-charge and institutional-control claims, crackdown framing, Hasina's electoral objective, and government denials."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports Hasina's statements on foreign pressure, dialogue, election institutions and safeguards, Ramadan rice assistance, LDC-related plans, and Rohingya shelter and services."]}]}
